description: Pokémon Gold / Silver / Crystal (Gen-2, GB/GBC). Shared engine; one game profile fits all three.

confirm.hint: Advance dialog one box. Talk to NPC facing you. Pick up the item on the tile in front. Confirm a menu choice. The single most-used button.

cancel.hint: Cancel / back out / close menu. Hold while walking to run (after the Running Shoes are obtained in Cherrygrove, Crystal only).

menu.hint: Open the main menu: Pokédex, Pokémon, Pack, Player, Save, Option, Exit. Overworld only.

registered.hint: Use the currently registered key item. Common registrations: Bicycle, Mystery Gift, ItemFinder.

nav_up.hint: Walk one tile north. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face north. Held: continuous walking.

nav_down.hint: Walk one tile south. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face south. Held: continuous walking.

nav_left.hint: Walk one tile west. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face west. Held: continuous walking.

nav_right.hint: Walk one tile east. First press while facing another direction just turns you to face east. Held: continuous walking.

notes: GSC has no L/R shoulders (Game Boy / Game Boy Color hardware). Identical action set to pokemon_rby plus the Select-bound registered key item which Gen-1 lacks.
